modos.descricao: Acao extra de combate Rg2 ou menos por rodada

params.descricao: 1 acao extra de combate Rg2 ou menos por rodada (inbloqueavel)
Se Bane, acoes extras podem ser ate Rg3

_metadata.texto_original: Weapon. This gory fetish is made from the tentacle of a Bane. The user may play an additional damage-dealing combat action of Rage 2 or less per round. A Bane may play actions up to Rage 3. The extra combat action played in this manner may not be blocked.
